name: scrapper-products
description: Monorepo: frontend Next.js (SSR) + backend NestJS integrado con la API de Mercado Libre

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.lint: npm --prefix backend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run lint
scripts.db:psql: docker compose exec postgres psql -U scrapper -d scrapper
scripts.docker:refresh:backend: docker compose stop backend && docker compose rm -f backend && docker volume rm -f scrapper-products_backend_node_modules && docker compose build backend && docker compose up -d backend
scripts.docker:refresh:frontend: docker compose stop frontend && docker compose rm -f frontend && docker volume rm -f scrapper-products_frontend_node_modules && docker compose build frontend && docker compose up -d frontend
